headline: State Street haggles over price tag for Brown Brothers acquisition
summary: There's a new wrinkle in State Street's long-delayed acquisition of BBH's investor services business: State Street wants a new price. If the deal doesn't close by Sept. 6, either party can walk away without penalty.
